title: Functional
text: Functional. I do a lot of cooking. At the present I have old style heavy Calphalon cookware that is great, but can't go into the dishwasher or the warranty will be voided.  I generally stay away from anything nonstick, but I got this set for the occasional  lightweight use of warming up a sauce or doing some eggs. Some days there just isn't enough energy left to wash more dishes and these can go into the dishwasher and come out OK.  They are lightweight quality, but the lids are very nice and I will probably use them more than the actual pans. The additional plastic tools and the baking sheet are of such low quality, that they will be relegated to the trash, or a yard sale. All in all this set would be acceptable for light use for a new cook that didn't have anything else. They specifically state that they are for use on low to medium heat, so that alone would rule out most uses for a real cook

description: Farberware provides classic quality and dependability cooks have relied on since 1900, with modern styling for today. This Farberware Dishwasher Safe Nonstick 15-Piece Cookware Set is constructed from sturdy aluminum that heats quickly and evenly to help reduce hot spots that can burn food. Long-lasting, top-quality nonstick coats the pots and pans for excellent food release, while the sleek cookware exteriors add a touch of style to any type of kitchen décor. Shatter-resistant glass lids feature easy-to-grasp knobs while allowing cooking to be watched without heat and moisture loss, and the double-riveted handles provide a strong grip. Oven safe to 350° F, as well as dishwasher safe, this nonstick cookware set comes with five nylon Prestige(r) cooking utensils ideal for nonstick surfaces. And don’t forget dessert – bake delicious bar, rolled or drop cookies to perfection on the medium cookie sheet, which is oven safe to 450° F. Get any kitchen started in quality and style with the Farberware Dishwasher Safe Nonstick 15-Piece Cookware Set, and leave cleanup to the dishwashing machine.
